text: The Brisco County audit released Tuesday by County Comptroller Elena Voss found that library equipment worth an estimated $48,700 was missing from the public records system, according to the audit report and an accompanying memorandum from County Administrator Darnell Price. The report said the unexplained shortages included three catalog scanners, six desktop terminals, two microfilm readers and assorted barcode hardware, all last inventoried in March. Ms. Voss said the discrepancies appeared in both the downtown and West Fork branches, and that purchase logs could not be matched to disposal forms. The county board has ordered a supplemental review by outside auditors and asked the sheriff’s office to determine whether the equipment was misplaced, transferred or stolen.
